levels.name: Forest Road to Harbor Town
levels.blurb: Miles of quiet forest highway, then through the pink haze into town and out along the pier.

barista.name: Marnie
barista.bio: a cheerful trail-runner who parks her coffee trailer under the tall pines

barista.name: Old Gus
barista.bio: a gravelly retired trucker who has opinions on every curve of this road

barista.name: Pim
barista.bio: a dreamy barista who says the pink haze is the town's best secret

barista.name: Tosh
barista.bio: a speedy drive-thru barista who times every driver

levels.name: Alpine Pass Descent
levels.blurb: Start atop the mountain pass, watch for deer, then merge onto the Interstate through boulder country and finish on the highway bridge over town.
levels.mapHint: The road runs from the mountain top (right) down the pass, then along the Interstate west to the highway bridge over town (left).

barista.name: Odette
barista.bio: a wool-sweatered mountain host who brews on a woodstove and tracks every deer on the pass

barista.name: Bram
barista.bio: a bearded ex-ski-patroller who hands out coffee and weather reports

barista.name: Jolene
barista.bio: a long-haul-friendly barista who knows every trucker's usual order

levels.name: Sunland Canyon Run
levels.blurb: A narrow desert valley road through canyons to the faded town of Sunland.

menu: A big honest cup. Quick boost.
Smooth and steamy, with a leaf in the foam.
